findings.finding: The instruction to use BenchmarkDotNet for in-process microbenchmarks is ambiguous with its InProcess toolchain and can guide implementation to measure the JIT driver instead of the generated NativeAOT executable.
findings.required_change: Specify isolated generated microbenchmark executables using the NativeAOT toolchain, with explicit ISA matching. Distinguish in-process diagnosers from the in-process execution toolchain.
findings.source_basis: CsProjNativeAotBuilder adds PublishAot and emits an executable; NativeAotTests selects CsProjNativeAotToolchain and tests actual RuntimeInformation.IsNativeAOT.

resolution.reviewed_disposition: Isolated NativeAOT executable requirement and explicit JIT InProcess prohibition inspected.

findings.finding: The codec cost table states three C exports, but the native source exports exactly nw_codec_run and nw_codec_release; the third count describes native tests, not exports.
findings.required_change: Correct the table to two exports without changing the three executed Rust test count.

resolution.reviewed_disposition: Two exports correct; three native tests retained separately.

findings.finding: After successful Run, output.Owner is an owned native allocation. Creating the SafeHandle wrapper with new Owner can fail before a managed owner exists; current code has no raw owner cleanup guard for that path. The normal using/finally lease covers only later failures.
findings.required_change: Provide ownership-transfer cleanup if wrapper construction fails, or create an invalid SafeHandle before native allocation and set its handle using a guaranteed nonthrowing transfer; add a deterministic post-native-success/wrapper-failure test and preserve old execution evidence.
findings.source_basis: D04/D11 output transfer and managed wrapper failure cleanup requirements; inspected Run and nw_codec_release establish native ownership on success.

resolution.reviewed_disposition: Guarded new Owner releases raw owner only on construction failure; constructor has no throwing work after SetHandle. Success path uses owner disposal and physical lease. Linux-reviewed normal/native/AOT regression passes.
resolution.validation_boundary: The allocation-failure branch was checked by control flow, not induced OOM or deterministic fault injection. A17 must inject that future product failure. Original Windows codec CI passed; corrected Linux run passed. Post-fix Windows regression is a separately identified pending addendum, not asserted here. This does not block the researched ownership rule.

findings.finding: Plan cross-review exposed ambiguous atomic multi-package publication; NuGet/crate registry uploads do not have one cross-package transaction.

resolution.reviewed_disposition: D10 section10 now limits atomic promotion to local staging/release catalog, publishes immutable dependencies first, verifies the full set before catalog exposure, and permits partial-upload resumption only after byte equality or a new version. No overwrite of published versions.

experiment_review.execution_by_reviewer: No upstream suite or experiment execution is claimed by this review. Author/CI raw execution logs and input snapshots were inspected independently and verified against retained hashes.
boundaries: Platform run43390177574 at4609bae29b0c367130a3a06b4bb9ebe3e74fd3ec actually proves default3 versus opt-in0 IAsyncStateMachine implementations and both AOT profiles ten assertions on Windows2022 and Ubuntu24.04.
Codec linux-reviewed passes three Rust tests,16 ordinary and17 AOT checks with corrected wrapper guard; guard failure itself not fault-injected and post-fix Windows regression not claimed yet.
Open-loop model is a finite synthetic counterexample, not an end-to-end latency result.

official_checks.finding: .NET 11 x86/x64 JIT and NativeAOT require x86-64-v2; stronger R2R targets are not the minimum.
As retrieved on 2026-11-13, .NET 11 released 2026-11-10 and is STS through 2028-11-14.
